source: 在此法术结束前，每当有生物对你发动攻击检定，该生物的该次攻击检定都将承受1d4减值。
target: Until this spell ends, whenever a creature makes an attack roll against you, it takes a 1d4 penalty to that roll.
note: Preserves every incoming attack roll, not a once-per-turn limit.

source: 你触碰一名自愿生物并选择一项技能。直到法术结束为止，受术生物在进行使用到所选技能的任何属性检定时，该次检定具有1d4加值。
target: You touch a willing creature and choose a skill. Until the spell ends, the creature gains a 1d4 bonus to any ability check it makes using the chosen skill.
note: The selected-skill restriction and every qualifying ability check are retained; no single-use consumption is added.

source:
选择一个生命值为0但还未死亡的生物，使该生物变为伤势稳定。
戏法强化：到达特定等级后，此法术的施法距离将翻倍：5级（30尺），11级（60尺），17级（120尺）。
target:
Choose a creature that has 0 Hit Points but isn't dead. That creature becomes Stable.
Cantrip Upgrade: At certain levels, this spell's range doubles: level 5 (30 feet), level 11 (60 feet), and level 17 (120 feet).
note: All three level/range bands are retained. The source body doesn't independently state the initial range, so none is added.

source: 在法术持续期间，当你首次进行智力检定失败时，若该检定的DC低于你的法术豁免DC，则自动视为成功；否则你获得+2加值。使用此效应后，需完成一次短休方可再次触发。
context: column:M;spell:Chant of Thoth;book:火炬光下的克苏鲁;level:0
target: For the duration, the first time you fail an Intelligence check, it automatically counts as a success if the check's DC is lower than your spell save DC; otherwise, you gain a +2 bonus. After using this effect, you must finish a Short Rest before it can trigger again.
note: Preserves the first failed check, strict lower-than comparison, alternative +2, and Short Rest reuse gate.

source: 你使施法距离内一个未被穿戴或携带的物体飞向你的空手。该物体重量不得超过10磅，否则法术失败。
target: You cause an object within range that isn't being worn or carried to fly into your empty hand. The object must weigh no more than 10 pounds, or the spell fails.
note: Keeps the empty-hand, worn/carried exclusion, and maximum weight with failure.

source: 你令根须从地面伸出并抓向触发借机攻击的生物，阻碍其移动。直到你的下个回合开始前，该生物的速度降低10尺。
target: You cause roots to reach out of the ground and grasp the creature that triggered the Opportunity Attack, hindering its movement. Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
note: The source refers to the triggering Opportunity Attack; no attack roll or save is added.

source: 你触碰一个自愿生物，掩盖其存在。直至该法术终止，其他生物对该目标进行的任何感知（洞悉或察觉）检定中必须减去1d4。
target: You touch a willing creature, concealing its presence. Until the spell ends, other creatures must subtract 1d4 from any Wisdom (Insight or Perception) check they make concerning the target.
note: Both Insight and Perception checks are retained; the penalty applies to other creatures' checks.

source: 刹那间，火花从你的手指间飞出，发出明亮的蓝光。这将照亮你周围60英尺的区域，直到你的下一个回合开始。对发现躲藏在阴影中的生物所进行的感知（察觉）检定具有优势。
target: Sparks burst from your fingers in a flash of bright blue light, illuminating the area within 60 feet of you until the start of your next turn. Wisdom (Perception) checks to spot creatures hiding in shadows have Advantage.
note: Preserves the source's timing, explicit feet, and shadow-hiding Perception scope without assigning the Advantage to a narrower observer.

source:
你祝福施法范围内至多三个生物。在法术终止前，受术目标进行的每次攻击检定与豁免检定都将获得1d4的加值。
升环施法：你使用的法术位每比一环高一环，就能多选择一个生物作为目标。
target:
You bless up to three creatures within range. Until the spell ends, each target gains a 1d4 bonus to every attack roll and saving throw it makes.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: You can target one additional creature for each slot level above level one.
note: All target, roll-type, and per-slot target-increase rules are complete.

source: 你射出一道炫目的闪耀彩光。以你为源点的15尺锥状区域内的每个生物必须成功通过一次体质豁免，否则陷入目盲状态，持续至下个你的回合结束。
target: You emit a dazzling spray of flashing colors. Each creature in a 15-foot Cone originating from you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn.
note: Retains the source's Constitution save and end-of-your-next-turn endpoint; no HP-pool mechanic is imported.

source: 你在法术持续时间内知晓你所听到或看到手语的所有语言的字面意义。你也可以通过触碰书写的文字来读懂其字面意义。以这种方式阅读每页文字需要花费 1 分钟的时间。这个法术并不能解读符号和暗语。
target: For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any language you hear or see being signed. You can also understand the literal meaning of written words by touching them. Reading each page this way takes 1 minute. The spell doesn't decipher symbols or coded messages.
note: Includes signed languages, physical contact for writing, per-page time, and symbol/code exclusion.

source:
你触碰的一名生物恢复等同于2d8+你施法属性调整值点生命值。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比一环高一环，此法术的治疗量就增加2d8点。
target:
A creature you touch regains Hit Points equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The healing increases by 2d8 for each slot level above level one.
note: Preserves the supplied base healing and upcast increment; no creature-type exclusion is added.

source:
在法术持续时间内，你定位距你30尺内的毒药、有毒生物和魔法疫病。你可以感知到毒药、有毒生物和疫病的种类。
此法术会被1尺厚的岩石、泥土或木头，1寸厚的金属，或薄薄一层铅阻隔。
context: column:M;spell:Detect Poison and Disease;book:玩家手册;level:1
target:
For the duration, you locate poisons, poisonous creatures, and magical diseases within 30 feet of you. You can sense the kinds of poison, poisonous creatures, and diseases.
The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, earth, or wood, 1 cun of metal, or a thin sheet of lead.
note: The source specifies magical diseases and groups stone/earth/wood under the 1-foot barrier. Bare cun is retained rather than assumed to be inches.

source: 直到法术结束之前，你使用武器的攻击在命中时造成额外1d4点光耀伤害。
target: Until the spell ends, your attacks with weapons deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage on a hit.
note: The weapon-attack scope is retained without extending it to all attacks.

source:
被该次攻击检定命中的目标会在此次攻击中额外受到2d8点光耀伤害。若目标为邪魔生物或亡灵生物，则此伤害增加1d8。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比一环高一环，此法术的伤害就提高1d8。
target:
The target hit by the triggering attack roll takes an extra 2d8 Radiant damage from that attack. If the target is a Fiend or Undead, this damage increases by 1d8.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The spell's damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above level one.
note: The triggering hit, two extra-damage creature types, and upcast increment are all retained.

source: 你执行疾走动作，且直到法术结束为止，你均能使用附赠动作执行疾走 动作。
target: You take the Dash action, and until the spell ends, you can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action.
note: Preserves the immediate Dash and subsequent Bonus Action Dash permission.

source:
你获得2d4+4点临时生命值。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比一环高一环，其给予的临时生命值就增加5。
target:
You gain 2d4 + 4 Temporary Hit Points.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The Temporary Hit Points granted increase by 5 for each slot level above level one.
note: Both base formula and fixed upcast increase retained.

source: 指定施法距离内至多五个正坠落的生物。受术生物的坠落速度在法术持续时间内降低至每回合60尺。如果该生物在法术终止前落地，则其不会受到任何坠落伤害，且着地后法术对该生物的效应随即终止。
target: Choose up to five falling creatures within range. For the duration, an affected creature's falling speed slows to 60 feet per turn. If it lands before the spell ends, it takes no falling damage, and the spell's effect on that creature ends when it lands.
note: The source says per turn, not per round; that distinction is retained. Landing ends only that creature's effect.

source:
你指定施法距离内一个你能看见的生物并恢复其生命值，恢复量等于2d4+你的施法属性调整值。
升环施法： 使用的法术位每比一环高一环，此法术的治疗量就增加2d4点。
target:
A creature you choose that you can see within range regains Hit Points equal to 2d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The healing increases by 2d4 for each slot level above level one.
note: Visibility, base healing, and upcast increment are complete.

source:
伤害你的生物立刻被绿色的烈焰席卷。该生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败则受到2d10点火焰伤害，豁免成功则受到一半伤害。
升环施法： 使用的法术位每比一环高一环，此法术的伤害就增加1d10点。
target:
The creature that damaged you is immediately engulfed in green flames. It must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above level one.
note: The damaging creature, green flame detail, Dexterity save, half damage, and upcasting are retained.

source:
你迫使触碰的一名生物进行体质豁免检定，豁免失败将受到 2d10 的暗蚀伤害，豁免成功则受到半数伤害。
升环施法：你使用的法术位每比一环高一环，暗蚀伤害就增加1d10。
target:
You force a creature you touch to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 2d10 Necrotic damage; on a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The Necrotic damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above level one.
note: Preserves touch and Constitution saving throw rather than substituting a spell attack from another edition.

source:
你触碰一个自愿生物。在法术结束前，每该生物他的回合内一次，其可以消耗10尺移动力来跳跃至多30尺距离。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比一环高一环，你就可以额外指定一个生物作为目标。
target:
You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, once on each of its turns, it can spend 10 feet of movement to jump up to 30 feet.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: You can target one additional creature for each slot level above level one.
note: The source's grammatical stumble is rendered as its stated once-on-the-creature's-turn rule, with both movement distances and extra targets retained.

source:
你触碰一个生物，该目标的速度增加10尺，直至法术结束。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比一环高一环，你就可以额外指定一个目标。
target:
You touch a creature, increasing its Speed by 10 feet until the spell ends.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: You can target one additional creature for each slot level above level one.
note: No willingness requirement is added where the body doesn't state one.

source: 你触碰一个未着装护甲的自愿生物。直至法术终止前，目标的基础AC变为 13+它的敏捷调整值。当目标穿上护甲时，此法术将提前终止。
target: You touch a willing creature that isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, its base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor.
note: Preserves willingness, armor exclusion, base AC formula, and donning-armor expiry.

source: 以施法距离内一点为中心，你移除半径5尺球状 区域内非魔法食物与饮品中的毒素和腐败。
context: column:M;spell:Purify Food and Drink;book:玩家手册;level:1
target: You remove poison and spoilage from nonmagical food and drink in a Sphere with a radius of 5 feet centered on a point within range.
note: The nonmagical restriction and both poison/spoilage removal are retained.

source: 一道看不见的力场制护盾浮现在你身旁，保护着你。在你的下一回合开始前，你的 AC 具有+5 加值（在触发该法术的攻击之前生效），并且不会受到魔法飞弹Magic Missle 的伤害。
target: An unseen shield of force appears beside you to protect you. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +5 bonus to AC, taking effect before the triggering attack, and you take no damage from Magic Missile.
note: Corrected the embedded English spelling using the same original workbook A127/N127 exact Magic Missile identity (level 1, Player Handbook); no source lookup key changed.

source: 一片闪着微光的能量场围绕着施法距离内你指定的一个生物，使目标在法术持续时间内AC获得+2 加值。
target: A shimmering field of energy surrounds a creature you choose within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.
note: The target choice, duration, and AC bonus are complete.

source:
选择一个视野内你可见且与你同等体型的类人生物。你的外形在法术持续时间内变化为该生物的完美复制。即便通过彻底的物理检查也无法分辨你与目标间的区别。
你的声音和装备不会变化。
context: column:M;spell:Body Warping of Gorgoroth;book:火炬光下的克苏鲁;level:1
target:
Choose a Humanoid you can see within your field of view that is the same size as you. For the duration, your appearance becomes a perfect copy of that creature. Even a thorough physical examination can't distinguish you from the target.
Your voice and equipment don't change.
note: Keeps Humanoid/same-size restrictions, physical-examination detail, and unchanged voice/equipment; no skill-check escape is added.

source: 当你施展此法术时，你的目光扫过一页书面文字并将其烙印于记忆中。此后一年内，你可以精确记住该页所有信息细节。一年后，你为回忆这些信息而进行的所有智力检定都具有优势。
target: When you cast this spell, your gaze sweeps over one page of writing and imprints it in your memory. For the next year, you can recall every detail of that page's information exactly. After that year, you have Advantage on all Intelligence checks to recall the information.
note: Preserves one page, exact recall for one year, and later Advantage rather than continuing perfect recall indefinitely.

source: 选择施法距离内一个你能看到的生物。你受到1d20点暗蚀伤害，而目标恢复等同于你所受伤害数值的生命值。
target: Choose a creature you can see within range. You take 1d20 Necrotic damage, and the target regains Hit Points equal to the damage you take.
note: Healing is based on damage actually taken, not merely the die result.

source: 你祈求祖先的智慧，以获得应对自身试炼的洞察力。当你施展该法术时，以及持续时间内每个你的回合开始时，你都会获得英雄激励（如果你尚未拥有）。
target: You invoke your ancestors' wisdom to gain insight into your trials. When you cast the spell and at the start of each of your turns for the duration, you gain Heroic Inspiration if you don't already have it.
note: Both acquisition times and the already-have-it restriction are retained.

source: 你对着一个生物念咒，将它笼罩在朦胧黑暗与寂静的面纱之中。目标在法术持续期间AC+1并在隐匿检定上具有优势。
context: column:M;spell:Veil of Dusk;book:谦卑林战役设定集;level:1
target: You incant over a creature, shrouding it in a veil of dim darkness and silence. For the duration, the target gains +1 AC and has Advantage on Stealth checks.
note: Preserves the AC and Stealth benefits without adding the separate Silence spell's mechanics.

source:
选择法术距离内至多三个生物。每个目标的生命值上限和当前生命值 在法术持续时间内提高5点。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比二环高一环，每个目标的生命值就额外提高 5 点。
target:
Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by 5 for the duration.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: Each target's Hit Points increase by an additional 5 for each slot level above level two.
note: Both current and maximum HP gains are retained; upcasting uses the source's same HP-increase context.

source: 你触碰一个自愿生物。直到法术终止前，目标的皮肤呈现出树皮样的外貌，并且若目标AC低于17，则其AC变为17。
target: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, its skin takes on a bark-like appearance, and if its AC is below 17, its AC becomes 17.
note: The exact AC floor, rather than an additive bonus, is preserved.

source: 你触碰一只自愿的野兽。在持续期间内，你可以借助该野兽的感官来感知周围事物，如同它们的感官是你的感官一般。以通过该野兽感官感知事物时，你同样会受益于它拥有的那些特殊感官。
target: You touch a willing Beast. For the duration, you can perceive your surroundings through its senses as though they were your own. While perceiving through the Beast's senses, you also benefit from its special senses.
note: No action cost or loss of the caster's own senses is imported from another version.

source: 你的身体变得模糊不定，难以捉摸。在法术持续时间内，所有生物对你发动的攻击检定具有劣势。不过若攻击者能通过盲视或真实视觉观测你，则其免疫于此法术的效应。
target: Your body becomes blurred and indistinct. For the duration, all creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker that can perceive you with Blindsight or Truesight is immune to this spell's effect.
note: Both sense exceptions are retained; no other special sense is assumed.

source: 你所触碰的物件上冒出火焰。这一效应发出半径20尺的明亮光照和额外20尺的微光光照。法术效应看上去与一般火焰无异，不过其并不会发热，也不需要燃料。你可以掩盖或隐藏火焰，但无法将其闷熄或扑灭。
target: A flame springs from an object you touch. It sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. It looks like an ordinary flame but produces no heat and needs no fuel. You can cover or hide the flame, but it can't be smothered or extinguished.
note: All light distances and heat/fuel/cover/extinguishing distinctions are preserved.

source: 你触碰一名自愿生物，该生物在法术持续时间内拥有150尺黑暗视觉。
target: You touch a willing creature, which gains Darkvision out to 150 feet for the duration.
note: Preserves the actual 150-foot range, not another edition's range.

source: 你触碰一个生物，并终止正影响它的一种状态：目盲，耳聋，麻痹或中毒 。
target: You touch a creature and end one condition affecting it: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.
note: All four choices retained, ending one condition only.

source: 你点名或描述一种特定的野兽生物、植物 生物或非魔法植物。如果5里内存在该类生物或植物，你将知晓其中最近的个体与你的相对方位和距离。
context: column:M;spell:Locate Animals or Plants;book:玩家手册;level:2
target: You name or describe a particular kind of Beast, Plant creature, or nonmagical plant. If any such creature or plant is within 5 li, you learn the direction and distance to the nearest one.
note: All three target categories and nearest-individual requirement retained. Bare li is not silently converted to miles.

source: 你短暂地被银白的雾气所笼罩，传送到至多30尺内一个你能看见且未被占据的空间。
target: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see up to 30 feet away.
note: The visible, unoccupied, maximum-distance destination requirements are preserved.

source: 你在法术持续时间于30尺光环范围内散发出遮蔽灵光。位于灵光范围期间，你和每名你选择的生物在敏捷（隐匿）检定上获得+10加值，且不会留下任何踪迹。
target: For the duration, you radiate a concealing aura in a 30-foot Emanation. While in the aura, you and each creature you choose gain a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks.
note: Preserves the while-inside restriction and all tracks, without substituting a narrower nonmagical-tracking clause.

source: 你触及一名生物并结束其陷入的中毒状态。在持续时间内，目标为避免陷入或结束中毒状态所做的豁免具有优势，且具有毒素伤害的抗性。
target: You touch a creature and end its Poisoned condition. For the duration, the target has Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Poisoned condition and has Resistance to Poison damage.
note: Immediate condition removal, both ongoing save scopes, and damage resistance are retained.

source: 在法术持续时间内，你能看见任何处于隐形状态的生物和物件，如同其处于正常可见状态一样。你还能够看见以太位面，以太位面的生物和物件在你眼中会以幽灵般的半透明形状显现。
target: For the duration, you see creatures and objects with the Invisible condition as though they were normally visible. You can also see into the Ethereal Plane; creatures and objects there appear to you as ghostly, translucent forms.
note: Preserves both creatures and objects in each visibility clause, with no additional range invented.

source: 你从至深的海沟下咒唤海水包围一个施法距离内你可见的生物。海水将渗入目标的嘴中并环绕其身体，缓慢地以大海深不可测的重压碾碎目标。目标承受3d6钝击伤害，且在持续时间内无法说话或使用含有言语成分的法术。
context: column:M;spell:Breath of the Deep;book:火炬光下的克苏鲁;level:2
target: You conjure seawater from the deepest ocean trenches to surround a creature you can see within range. The water seeps into the target's mouth and swirls around its body, slowly crushing it under the unfathomable pressure of the deep sea. The target takes 3d6 Bludgeoning damage and can't speak or use spells with Verbal components for the duration.
note: All descriptive content, damage, speech block, and Verbal-component restriction are complete; no save or suffocation rule is added.

source:
在范围内选择三个生物。每个生物获得10点临时生命值。
升环施法效应：使用三环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比二环高一环，提供的临时生命值就多5点。
target:
Choose three creatures within range. Each gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell with a level-three or higher slot, the Temporary Hit Points granted increase by 5 for each slot level above level two.
note: The source says three creatures, not up to three. Both level thresholds and HP values retained.

source: 你短暂减缓施法距离内一个你选择的你可见生物的时间。目标必须进行一次感知豁免检定，豁免失败则从下一轮开始被移动至先攻序列的最后一位。
target: You briefly slow time for a creature you choose that you can see within range. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it moves to the last position in the Initiative order starting with the next round.
note: The next-round timing and failed-save Initiative movement are retained without inventing an earlier turn loss.

source: 目标的武器将发生故障，本次攻击失手。武器故障后将无法被使用，直至有生物用利用动作将武器的故障修理完毕为止。
context: column:M;spell:Jam Weapon;book:瓦尔达的秘密尖塔;level:2
target: The target's weapon malfunctions, and the attack misses. The malfunctioning weapon can't be used until a creature takes a Utilize action to repair it.
note: Preserves the failed attack and lasting malfunction repair requirement; no weapon type is added to the body.

source: 你选择施法距离内一个你能看见的物件，使其变为隐形直到法术结束。该物件不能大于5尺边长的立方体，且不能是由生物穿戴的物品。
target: Choose an object you can see within range. It becomes Invisible until the spell ends. It must fit within a 5-foot Cube and can't be worn by a creature.
note: The source excludes worn objects but not all carried objects; that distinction is preserved.

source: 一阵旋转的暴风将你托起，并把你送到施法距离内一个你能看见的生物处。在本回合结束前，由于狂风的冲击，你下一次使用近战武器攻击命中生物时，该攻击额外造成2d6点挥砍伤害。
target: A swirling gale lifts you and carries you to a creature you can see within range. Before this turn ends, the next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, the force of the wind causes that attack to deal an extra 2d6 Slashing damage.
note: The movement destination, next successful melee weapon hit, and current-turn expiry are all retained.

source: 你将自身裹于阴影之中，在攻击间隙为你提供遮掩。在你用一次攻击检定命中一个生物的任何回合结束时，你获得隐形状态，直至你的下一回合开始。
context: column:M;spell:Veil of the Reaper;book:歪曲之月;level:2
target: You wrap yourself in shadows that conceal you between attacks. At the end of any turn on which you hit a creature with an attack roll, you gain the Invisible condition until the start of your next turn.
note: The trigger is any turn with a hit, not only your own turn. Endpoint remains the start of your next turn.

source: 墨色的灵光在法术持续时间内环绕你触碰的一名生物。该生物进行的死亡豁免具有优势，且每回合一次，当位于法术目标5尺内的生物用近战攻击检定命中法术目标时，该攻击者受2d4暗蚀伤害。
context: column:M;spell:Death Armor;book:被遗忘的国度：费伦英雄;level:2
target: An inky aura surrounds a creature you touch for the duration. It has Advantage on Death Saving Throws. Once per turn, when a creature within 5 feet of the target hits it with a melee attack roll, that attacker takes 2d4 Necrotic damage.
note: The per-turn retaliation limit, attacker proximity, melee hit requirement, and separate death-save benefit are retained.

source: 奥术法阵令你能在持续时间内抵抗魔法。你对抗法术和其他魔法效应时进行的豁免检定具有优势。此外，若你对抗豁免成功受半数伤害的法术或魔法效应时，若豁免成功则不受伤害。
context: column:M;spell:Elminster's Elusion;book:被遗忘的国度：费伦英雄;level:2
target: An arcane circle helps you resist magic for the duration. You have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. In addition, when you succeed on a save against a spell or magical effect that normally deals half damage on a successful save, you instead take no damage.
note: The source's successful-save damage avoidance is not expanded to half damage on failed saves.

source: 一道灵光自你身上发出并形成30尺半径的光环 。当你创造灵光时和它持续时你的每个回合开始，你可以为区域内的一名生物回复2d6点生命值。
target: An aura extends from you in an Emanation with a radius of 30 feet. When you create the aura and at the start of each of your turns while it lasts, you can restore 2d6 Hit Points to one creature in the area.
note: Both healing triggers, optional healing, and one creature in the area retained; no Bonus Action cost is added.

source: 在施法距离内指定任意数量的生物，并使其在法术持续时间内进行的感知豁免和死亡豁免具有优势。此外，其获得的所有治疗的生命值恢复量都取最大值。
target: Choose any number of creatures within range. For the duration, they have Advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Death Saving Throws. They also regain the maximum possible Hit Points from all healing they receive.
note: Both save categories and all healing maximization are complete.

source: 你试图打断一名正在施法的生物。该生物进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败则法术消散且毫无效果，并且用于施展法术的动作、附赠动作或反应随之浪费。如果那道法术是使用法术位施展的，则法术位并不会被消耗。
target: You attempt to interrupt a creature that is casting a spell. It makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, its spell dissipates without effect, and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is wasted. If the spell was cast with a spell slot, that slot isn't expended.
note: Preserves Constitution save, wasted action economy, and unspent slot. No older-edition ability check or automatic spell-level success is substituted.

source: 你在30尺光环区域内散发出魔法灵光。位于灵光范围期间，你和你盟友以一把武器或一次徒手打击命中时将额外造成1d4光耀伤害。
target: You radiate a magical aura in a 30-foot Emanation. While in the aura, you and your allies each deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage on a hit with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.
note: Each eligible creature adds damage to its own hit; retained the source weapon or Unarmed Strike alternatives and 1d4 damage.

source:
指定施法距离内至多六个你能看见的生物，使它们恢复 2d4+你的施法属性调整值 点生命值。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比三环高一环，此法术的治疗量就增加1d4。
target:
Choose up to six creatures you can see within range. Each regains Hit Points equal to 2d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The healing increases by 1d4 for each slot level above level three.
note: Preserves the supplied 2d4 base and distinct 1d4 upcast increment.

source: 法术持续时间内，你使你触及的目标不会被预言法术发现。目标可以是一名自愿生物，或者是在任何方向上都不超过10尺的一处地点或一个物件。目标不能被任何预言法术选为目标，也不能被魔法探知传感器感测到。
target: For the duration, you conceal a target you touch from Divination spells. The target can be a willing creature, or a place or object no more than 10 feet in any dimension. It can't be targeted by any Divination spell or perceived by magical scrying sensors.
note: The size limit applies to the place/object alternative; both divination targeting and sensor detection are blocked.

source: 法术持续时间内，你触及的一名自愿生物具有你选择的一种伤害类型的抗性：强酸、寒冷、火焰、闪电、雷鸣。
target: For the duration, a willing creature you touch has Resistance to one damage type you choose: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder.
note: All five damage-type choices retained; no Poison resistance is added.

source: 你触及一名生物或一个物件，使影响其的所有诅咒终止。如果该物件是一件诅咒魔法物品，则其上的诅咒不会因此解除，不过该法术可以打破诅咒物品与其所有者之间的同调，使其所有者可以将其卸下或丢弃。
target: You touch a creature or object and end all curses affecting it. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse isn't removed, but the spell breaks the item's Attunement to its owner so the owner can remove or discard it.
note: Preserves the cursed-item exception and Attunement-breaking result rather than removing the item's curse.

source: 你接触在前一分钟内刚刚死亡的一名生物。该生物以1点生命值回生。该法术不能复活老死的生物，也不能恢复失去的身体部位。
target: You touch a creature that died within the last minute. It returns to life with 1 Hit Point. The spell can't restore life to a creature that died of old age or restore missing body parts.
note: All eligibility, restored HP, and both exclusions retained.

source: 此法术赋予你触碰的一名生物理解任何其能看见或听见的口语或手语的能力。此外，当目标生物以口语或手语进行交流时，任何能听见其话语或看见其手语，且知道至少一门语言的生物都能理解它。
target: This spell gives a creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken or signed language it can hear or see. When the target communicates by speech or signs, any creature that can hear its words or see its signs and knows at least one language can understand it.
note: Both spoken and signed communication directions are retained. Raw N spells the name Tounges; that identity is not silently renamed.

source: 在法术终止前，该法术让施法距离内你所选择的至多十个自愿生物获得在水下呼吸的能力。此外，受术者依然保有正常的呼吸能力。
target: Until the spell ends, up to ten willing creatures you choose within range gain the ability to breathe underwater. They also retain their normal modes of breathing.
note: The ten willing targets and retained normal breathing remain intact.

source: 你释放出一股恶意汹涌的气场，使靠近你的生物晕头转向。任何在你10尺范围内开始回合的生物都将陷入中毒状态，直到它们的下一个回合开始。
target: You emanate a surging aura of malice that disorients nearby creatures. Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of you has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn.
note: The source gives no save or ally exemption; none is added. Trigger and endpoint are the affected creature's turns.

source: 一道闪烁的光带射向施法距离内的一个目标，并在一道壮丽的光芒中将其包裹。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。命中时，目标被束缚，且被魔法固定在原地直到其下一回合结束。
target: A flashing ribbon of light shoots toward a target within range and wraps it in a magnificent glow. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it has the Restrained condition and is magically fixed in place until the end of its next turn.
note: The hit requirement, Restrained condition, immobility, and target-next-turn endpoint are preserved.

source: 一道灵光自你身上发出并形成 30 尺半径的光环。在灵光范围内时，你和你的盟友获得对暗蚀伤害的抗性，生命值上限也无法被降低。另外，生命值为0的盟友在灵光范围内开始其回合时，恢复1点生命值。
target: An aura extends from you in an Emanation with a radius of 30 feet. While in the aura, you and your allies have Resistance to Necrotic damage, and your Hit Point maximums can't be reduced. In addition, an ally with 0 Hit Points that starts its turn in the aura regains 1 Hit Point.
note: The source's zero-HP recovery clause explicitly names an ally; no extra self-recovery clause is added.

source: 一道灵光自你身上发出并形成 30 尺半径的光环。在灵光范围内时，你和你的盟友获得毒素伤害的抗性，并且在为抵抗和结束下列状态所做的豁免时具有优势：目盲、魅惑、耳聋、恐慌、麻痹、中毒、震慑 。
target: An aura extends from you in an Emanation with a radius of 30 feet. While in the aura, you and your allies have Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saves to resist or end the following conditions: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, and Stunned.
note: All seven conditions and both resist/end save scopes are complete.

source: 触碰一名生物，该生物直到法术结束之前具有隐形状态。
target: Touch a creature. It has the Invisible condition until the spell ends.
note: The source contains no willingness or additional effect clause; none is added.

source: 在法术结束前，你触碰的一个自愿生物获得对钝击、穿刺、挥砍伤害的抗性。
target: Until the spell ends, a willing creature you touch has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
note: The source doesn't restrict this resistance to nonmagical attacks; no such restriction is inserted.

source: 你诅咒施法距离内的一个生物，使其内心充满逐渐蔓延的偏执与绝望。当目标执行攻击或魔法动作时，其必须进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败则浪费其动作。一旦目标在对抗该法术的豁免检定中累计成功三次，则该法术终止。
target: You curse a creature within range, filling its mind with spreading paranoia and despair. When the target takes the Attack or Magic action, it must make a Wisdom saving throw, wasting its action on a failed save. The spell ends once the target has accumulated three successful saves against it.
note: Both action types and three accumulated successes retained; consecutive successes are not required by the source.

source: 抗拒生命的能量以你为源头形成半径30尺的灵光，在法术持续时间内，灵光将以你为中心随你移动。当一名生物进入灵光区域或在范围内开始其回合时，其受到1d6暗蚀伤害，你恢复等于灵光造成的伤害数的生命值。
target: Life-repelling energy forms an aura with a radius of 30 feet originating from you. For the duration, it remains centered on you and moves with you. When a creature enters the aura or starts its turn there, it takes 1d6 Necrotic damage, and you regain Hit Points equal to the damage the aura deals.
note: Preserves both triggers and actual damage-based healing. No unprinted once-per-turn limit, save, or ally exemption is added.

source: 你在30尺光环区域内散发灵光。位于灵光范围期间，你和你的盟友为对抗法术或其他魔法效应而进行的豁免检定具有优势。当受该法术效应影响的生物对抗豁免成功受半数伤害的法术或魔法效应时，若其豁免成功则不受伤害。
target: You radiate an aura in a 30-foot Emanation. While in the aura, you and your allies have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. When a creature affected by this spell succeeds on a save against a spell or magical effect that normally deals half damage on a successful save, it instead takes no damage.
note: Successful-save damage avoidance is preserved without adding a failed-save reduction.

source: 毁灭能量从你身上扩散而出，覆盖了30尺光环范围。光环范围内你选择的每个生物进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败者受到5d6点雷鸣伤害和5d6点光耀或暗蚀伤害（由你选择）并且陷入倒地状态。豁免成功只受一半伤害。
target: Destructive energy radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation. Each creature you choose in the area makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 5d6 Thunder damage and 5d6 Radiant or Necrotic damage, your choice, and has the Prone condition. On a successful save, it takes only half as much damage.
note: Both damage components, the Radiant/Necrotic choice, Constitution save, and failure-only Prone condition retained.

source: 你行使宇宙的自然秩序，将一个神话实体强行遣返其来处。选择施法距离内一位你可见的处于浴血的神话生物或神话神祇。目标会被传送至一个与其生物类型相关的位面（由DM选择）中的一个随机位置。
context: column:M;spell:Dismiss Deity;book:火炬光下的克苏鲁;level:5
target: You invoke the natural order of the cosmos to force a mythos entity back to where it came from. Choose a Bloodied mythos creature or mythos deity you can see within range. It is teleported to a random location on a plane associated with its creature type, chosen by the DM.
note: Preserves Bloodied eligibility, both mythos target categories, DM's plane choice, and random arrival location. No new saving throw is supplied.

source: 你触碰一个非魔法的微型物件，在持续时间内将你的一部分运气注入其中。当另一个生物携带该物件期间，该生物在D20检定中具有优势，而你在D20检定中具有劣势。
context: column:M;spell:Sanctum of the Flock;book:歪曲之月;level:5
target: You touch a Tiny nonmagical object and imbue it with part of your luck for the duration. While another creature carries the object, it has Advantage on D20 Tests, and you have Disadvantage on D20 Tests.
note: This is the actual M646 body attached to the row's raw identity; it is translated as written without substituting another same-name Sanctum body. Both opposed D20 benefits/penalties require another creature to carry the object.

source: 触发生物必须进行一次感知豁免。若豁免失败，则其受到等于对你盟友所造成伤害的心灵伤害。若豁免成功，则其受到一半伤害。
target: The triggering creature must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes Psychic damage equal to the damage it dealt to your ally. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
note: The original triggering damage is the damage dealt to your ally, not to the caster; both save outcomes are preserved.

source: 你邀请灵魄向目标复仇。施法距离内一可见生物需进行一次魅力豁免。魅力为2或更低的生物不受此法术影响。豁免失败时目标受到8d8心灵伤害，并被你恐慌，直到法术结束。豁免成功则受到的伤害减半且不会被恐慌。
target: You invite spirits to take vengeance on a target. A creature you can see within range must make a Charisma saving throw. A creature with Charisma of 2 or lower is unaffected. On a failed save, the target takes 8d8 Psychic damage and is Frightened of you until the spell ends. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't Frightened.
note: Preserves the Charisma-score exemption, Charisma save, and failure-only Frightened-of-you effect.

source: 法术持续时间内，你触碰的自愿生物具有120尺真实视觉。
target: For the duration, a willing creature you touch has Truesight out to 120 feet.
note: Only the supplied short Truesight effect is translated; no additional perception mechanic is imported.

source:
一顶圣光燃烧的王冠装饰在你的头上直到法术结束。任何移动进入你20尺内或在你20尺内开始回合的邪魔、妖精或亡灵受到2d8光耀伤害。
光耀冠冕会在其半径30尺内提供明亮光照并在该范围外30尺提供微光光照。
target:
A crown burning with holy light adorns your head until the spell ends. Any Fiend, Fey, or Undead that moves into the area within 20 feet of you or starts its turn within 20 feet of you takes 2d8 Radiant damage.
The Crown of Radiance sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.
note: Retained the source entry trigger: movement into the area, not arbitrary movement already inside it. No new saving throw or frequency limit added.
